definition: AMiner (formerly ArnetMiner) is a free online service used to index, search, and mine big scientific data..
details: AMiner (formerly ArnetMiner) is a free online service used to index, search, and mine big scientific data.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. And that is AMiner (database) — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
